card.name: Linking words in healthy natural food lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (such as, and, with, consider) inside lists of healthy, natural foods or eco-friendly products, just before the next item is named.

modes.label: Healthy food lists
modes.description: Connector or comma inside a list of whole foods like fruit, nuts, seeds, honey, greens.
modes.example: When a sweetener is required, consider natural sources such<< as>> raw honey and maple syrup instead.

modes.label: Organic product lists
modes.description: Connector before more items in an organic or earth-friendly product list.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like sustainable, organic, natural and eco as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words when a text is about to list natural, healthy or organic items.
